verified_behavior: A flagged FE content-guard result does not call the publish endpoint.
A RECIPE_MODERATION_FAILED response keeps the recipe in DRAFT and does not navigate away from the editor.
The user can retry after moderation becomes approved and reaches the recipe route.
The backend service propagates moderation rejection before quality scoring, repository save, or recipe-index event publication.
limitations: Playwright intercepts API calls with local fixtures; no live FE-to-Monolith browser transaction was exercised.
The backend unit test uses Mockito; Mongo persistence, Kafka delivery, and index delivery were not exercised.
No production moderation provider or deployed environment was used.
initial_browser_attempt: The first run used a text locator for a title rendered in an input value. The test failed at setup; the locator was corrected to assert the textbox value, after which the new case passed on both viewports. No product failure was observed in that initial attempt.
